text.en: How should we walk through the years: afraid of the road or glad to take it?

The poet prays to live life from year to year with a forward face and an unreluctant soul. He does not want to hurry towards the goal or turn away from it, to mourn the past or fear the future. Whether the road goes up or down, over rough or smooth, the journey will be joy for a heart that keeps its courage.
The poem is optimistic. It values friendship, adventure and hope, and keeps the spirit of the quest as one grows old. Life is a journey to be enjoyed, not merely endured.
Notice the rhyme scheme of this sonnet-like poem and words like unreluctant, veils, toll and quest.
